# CarouselFlick (Carousel V11 Recreation)

- **Source:** ColorLib Carousel 11 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-11/`)
- **Preview URL:** `https://colorlib.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/carousel-11.jpg`
- **New Name:** `carouselflick` (`apps/carouselflick`)
- **Category:** Carousel / Portfolio Showcase

## Structure & Section Order

1. **Navbar:** Fixed/sticky header with logo, navigation links, and CTA button.
2. **Hero Carousel:** Immersive multi-slide carousel with active slide image, heading, subtitle, category tag, prev/next arrows, and slide counters (`01 / 05`).
3. **Thumbnail Navigation:** Quick-select row of thumbnail previews mapped to carousel slides.
4. **Highlights / Features:** 3-column grid highlighting key aspects of the showcase.
5. **Newsletter Banner:** Email subscription form with instant validation feedback.
6. **Footer:** Copyright, navigation links, social icons, and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Tokens & Styling Notes

- Dark theme aesthetic inspired by modern portfolio and slider showcases (`#020617` background, `#0f172a` cards, `#f59e0b` amber accents).
- Fully responsive layout with Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes.
- Accessible keyboard navigation and aria labels for carousel controls.
